name: cavemio-chat-notice
title: Error and limit states
description: Calm, specific notices for failed answers, being offline, rate limits and chats that grow too long.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Errors use role="alert"; the other kinds use role="status", so screen readers hear them without interruption. The ticking digits are hidden from them (they hear the time it resets instead), so the countdown never chatters.
- The countdown starts once mounted, cleans up its timer and calls onReset once when the limit resets.
- Installs Number roll, Status button and Text morph. With reduced motion, states change in place.
- Actions wrap under the text on narrow screens.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: kind
props.description: – · Picks the icon, wording and actions.

props.name: resetAt / onReset
props.description: – · Rate limit: when sending is allowed again, with a live countdown.

props.name: onRetry / retrying
props.description: – · Retry button, with a spinner (or "Reconnecting" when offline) while it runs.

props.name: onSummarize / onNewChat
props.description: – · Context: continue with a summary, or start over.

useCases.title: Failed answers
useCases.description: Tell people the answer didn’t arrive, that their message is safe, and let them retry.

useCases.title: Free plan limits
useCases.description: Show when sending is allowed again, with a way to upgrade.

useCases.title: Lost connections
useCases.description: Say the chat will pick up when the connection is back.

useCases.title: Long conversations
useCases.description: When the context is full, offer a new chat or a summary to continue with.

features.title: Failed answers
features.description: “Something went wrong”, a note that the message is safe, and Retry, which spins and reads “Retrying”. Technical details sit behind “Show details”.

features.title: Offline
features.description: Explains that it will pick up when the connection is back, shows “Reconnecting”, and offers “Try now”.

features.title: Rate limits with a countdown
features.description: The time left rolls down, then the notice becomes “You can send messages again” and Upgrade folds away.

features.title: Chats that grow too long
features.description: Offers a new chat, or continuing with a summary of this one.

features.title: Calm for screen readers
features.description: Errors use role alert and the rest use status. The ticking digits are hidden, so the countdown never chatters.

features.title: One component, four kinds
features.description: The kind picks the icon, the words and the actions. Override the title and description when you need to.

states.title: error
states.description: "Something went wrong", reassurance that the message is safe, and Retry: a Status button whose spinner opens in as it morphs to "Retrying". Details fold open (420ms) as "Show details" morphs to "Hide details".

states.title: offline
states.description: Explains it will pick up when the connection is back; "Reconnecting" opens in with a soft pulse while retrying, and "Try now" spins while it tries.

states.title: rate-limit
states.description: The countdown rolls down a second at a time (00 rolls back to 59). At zero the hourglass blurs into a check that draws itself, the title and description morph to "You can send messages again" / "Your limit has reset." and Upgrade folds away.

states.title: context
states.description: Offers a new chat, or continuing with a summary of this one.
